resources.string: Nickname (if any) used to identify this account within HHPhone app.
Authentication Password up to 64 characters. If Authentication Username is given, but Password is not given, it will be asked when HHPhone is started.
Tells how often (in seconds) HHPhone sends REGISTER requests. Valid values are from 60 to 3600.
If checked, this account is selected when HHPhone is started.
If checked, HHPhone starts automatically after device boots or after a new version of HHPhone is installed. Start is delayed until device is unlocked.
Disable battery optimizations if you want to reduce likelihood that Android restricts HHPhone\'s access to network or enters HHPhone to standby state.
If checked, HHPhone is the default phone app.
If checked, HHPhone is the default messaging app for SMS/MMS.

IP address and port of form \'address:port\' at which HHPhone listens for incoming SIP requests. If IP address is an IPv6 address, it must be written inside brackets []. IPv4 address 0.0.0.0 or IPv6 address [::] makes HHPhone listen at all available addresses. If left empty (factory default), HHPhone listens at an arbitrary port at all available addresses.
Chooses which IP addresses HHPhone is using. If IPv4 or IPv6 is chosen, HHPhone uses only IPv4 or IPv6 addresses. If neither is chosen, HHPhone uses both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.

If checked, a file containing TLS certificate and private key of this HHPhone instance has been or will be loaded. In Android version 9, a file called \'cert.pem\' is loaded from Download folder. For security reasons, delete the file after loading.
If checked, HHPhone verifies TLS certificates of SIP User Agent and SIP Proxy Servers when TLS transport is used.
Chooses if HHPhone contacts, Android contacts, or both are used. If both are used and a contact with the same name exists in both contacts, the HHPhone contact will be chosen.
If checked and if Debug is checked, Logcat messages include also SIP request and response trace. Unchecked automatically at HHPhone start.
You need to restart HHPhone in order to activate the new settings. Restart now?

If Android contacts is chosen, they can be used in calling and messaging as references to SIP and tel URIs. HHPhone app does not store Android contacts nor share them with anyone. In order to make Android contacts available in HHPhone, Google requires that you accept their use as described here and in app\'s Privacy Policy.
HHPhone failed to start. This may be due to an invalid Settings value. Check Listen Address, TLS Certificate File, and TLS CA File. Then restart HHPhone.
Failed to back up application data to file \'%1$s\'. Check Apps → HHPhone → Permissions → Storage.
Application data restored. HHPhone needs to be restarted. Restart now?

Failed to restore application data. Check that you gave correct password and that the backup file is from this application. In Android versions 9, also check Apps → HHPhone → Permissions → Storage and that file \'%1$s\' exists in Download folder.
HHPhone needs \"Microphone\" permission for voice calls.

HHPhone needs \"Microphone\" permission for voice calls, \"Nearby devices\" permission for Bluetooth microphone/speaker detection, \"Notifications\" permission for posting notifications, and in Android 9 \"Storage\" permission for Backup/Restore operations.

HHPhone needs \"Microphone\" permission for voice calls, \"Camera\" permission for video calls, \"Nearby devices\" permission for Bluetooth microphone/speaker detection, \"Notifications\" permission for posting notifications, and in Android 9 \"Storage\" permissions for Backup/Restore operations.
